title: LocationSaver
description: Save, manage, and recall personal Minecraft locations.
body:
[![AshCraft](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a75887d69106ed9eb2dd595176121f279523f184_0.webp)](https://www.ashcraft.cz/)

LocationSaver is a simple yet powerful plugin that allows players to save, view, and manage their favorite spots in the world. With just a few commands, players can store their current position under a custom name and easily recall the exact coordinates later. Whether it’s a hidden base, a mining outpost, or a scenic build site, LocationSaver ensures you never lose track of important places.

Players can use /save <name> to store their current position (automatically rounded to block coordinates), /show <name> to display the saved location details, /delete <name> to remove entries, and /list to quickly review all stored locations. Each location is tied to the player who saved it, ensuring personal organization and privacy.

The plugin is permission-based, giving server administrators full control over who can save, view, list, or delete locations. Saved data is stored in a dedicated configuration file (locations.yml), keeping everything persistent between server restarts.

With its clean implementation, user-friendly commands, and data persistence, LocationSaver is a must-have utility plugin for survival servers, building communities, or any world where remembering coordinates is essential.
